questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 20 cm and a height of 9 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 20 × 9 = 90 cm² — remember to halve after multiplying.
